applies_why: The judge text addresses whether the Luke 2:48-49 point counts as answered or unanswered by naming earlier rounds, which is the conduct K-G4 governs.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: If the judge says a verse was answered — I weighed whether 'answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4' is an actual statement that the verse was answered, versus a mere label of the issue as underdetermined that still counts it.
why: The judge says the Luke 2:48-49 point was answered in earlier rounds, so K-G4 forbids counting it and the text does not count it as an unanswered witness.
